design.text: International multicenter, open-label, single-arm trial of subcutaneous omacetaxine in adult CML patients

citations.quote: Trials CML-202 and CML-203 were similar in design and both were international multicenter open label single arm trials evaluating the safety and efficacy of SC omacetaxine in the treatment of adult patients with CML-CP, CML-AP, and CML-BP,

population.text: Adult CML-CP and CML-AP patients who received 2 or more approved TKIs with documented resistance or intolerance to dasatinib and/or nilotinib (pooled subset analysis CML-300)

citations.quote: The efficacy of SYNRIBO was evaluated using a combined cohort of adult patients with CML from two trials. The combined cohort consisted of patients who had received 2 or more approved TKIs and had, at a minimum, documented evidence of resistance or intolerance to dasatinib and/or nilotinib.

endpoint.text: MCyR (major cytogenetic response) for CP CML; MaHR (major hematologic response = CHR or NEL) for AP CML

citations.quote: The efficacy endpoint was based on MCyR (adjudicated by a DMC).
The efficacy endpoint was assessed based on MCyR and MaHR (complete hematologic response [CHR] or no evidence of leukemia [NEL]).

n.text: CP CML efficacy population N=76; AP CML efficacy population N=35

citations.quote: A total of 76 patients with chronic phase CML were included in the efficacy analysis.
A total of 35 patients with accelerated phase CML were included in the efficacy analysis.

result.text: CP CML: MCyR 14 (18.4%) (95% CI 10.5%–29.0%), median MCyR duration 12.5 months. AP CML: MaHR 5 (14.3%) (95% CI 4.5%–30.3%), median MaHR duration 4.7 months

indication.text: Treatment of adult patients with chronic or accelerated phase CML with resistance and/or intolerance to two or more tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKI); indication based upon response rate

citations.quote: SYNRIBO for Injection is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with chronic or accelerated phase chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) with resistance and/or intolerance to two or more tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKI). This indication is based upon response rate. There are no trials verifying an improvement in disease-related symptoms or increased survival with SYNRIBO. (1)

target_moa.text: Mechanism not fully elucidated but includes inhibition of protein synthesis, independent of direct Bcr-Abl binding; binds the A-site cleft in the peptidyl-transferase center of the large ribosomal subunit and reduces Bcr-Abl protein levels

citations.quote: The mechanism of action of omacetaxine mepesuccinate has not been fully elucidated but includes inhibition of protein synthesis and is independent of direct Bcr-Abl binding. Omacetaxine mepesuccinate binds to the A-site cleft in the peptidyl-transferase center of the large ribosomal subunit from a strain of archaeabacteria. In vitro, omacetaxine mepesuccinate reduced protein levels of the Bcr-Abl

modality.text: Small molecule (cephalotaxine ester; protein synthesis inhibitor), molecular weight 545.6 g/mol

citations.quote: The molecular formula is C_{29}H_{39}NO_9 with a molecular weight of 545.6 g/mol. SYNRIBO for injection is a sterile, preservative-free, white to off-white, lyophilized powder in a single-use vial. Each vial contains 3.5 mg omacetaxine mepesuccinate and mannitol.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%): thrombocytopenia, anemia, neutropenia, diarrhea, nausea, fatigue, asthenia, injection site reaction, pyrexia, infection, lymphopenia. Grade 3/4 thrombocytopenia (85% CP, 88% AP), neutropenia (81% CP, 71% AP), anemia (62% CP, 80% AP); fatalities related to myelosuppression in 3% of safety population (N=163)

citations.quote: CML-Chronic Phase and Accelerated Phase: Most common adverse reactions (frequency \ge 20%): thrombocytopenia, anemia, neutropenia, diarrhea, nausea, fatigue, asthenia, injection site reaction, pyrexia, infection, and lymphopenia. (6.1)

In uncontrolled trials with SYNRIBO, patients with chronic phase and accelerated phase CML experienced NCI CTC (version 3.0) Grade 3 or 4 thrombocytopenia (85%, 88%), neutropenia (81%, 71%), and anemia (62%, 80%), respectively. Fatalities related to myelosuppression occurred in 3% of patients in the safety population (N=163).

vote.text: No advisory committee convened for this submission; the applicant dropped the T315I indication and the division had approved other CML agents on similar single-arm response data (a prior ODAC for NDA 22374 was held March 22, 2010)

citations.quote: This submission was not taken to an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because the Applicant decided to forgo pursuing an indication for CML associated with a T315I Bcr-Abl mutation and the division has approved other agents to treat CML based on single arm response data using the same response criteria.

detail.text: NDA 203585 (submitted March 30, 2012) was approved under accelerated approval on the first cycle. A prior complete response letter (April 8, 2010) was issued for a different application, NDA 22374, not for this NDA

citations.quote: On April 8, 2010, Cephalon received a complete response (CR) letter for NDA 22374 which outlined clinical, clinical pharmacology, nonclinical and product quality issues.
It is approved under the provisions of accelerated approval regulations (21 CFR 314.500), effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed agreed-upon labeling text.

Please refer to your New Drug Application (NDA) dated March 30, 2012, received March 30, 2012, submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FDCA) for Synribo (omacetaxine mepesuccinate) lyophilized powder for injection, 3.5 mg/vial.

requirement.text: 1930-1: Continue follow-up of patients and submit a final analysis report of CGX-635-CML-300 with 24 months of minimum follow-up data for each patient (accelerated approval confirmatory requirement)

citations.quote: 1930-1 Continue follow-up of patients (on treatment and in protocol defined post-treatment follow-up) and submit a final analysis report of CGX-635-CML-300 with 24 months of minimum follow-up data for each patient. If 24 months of follow-up is not possible for certain patients, justification should be provided.

requirement.text: 1930-2: Conduct a Phase 1/2 single-arm trial to investigate the PK, safety, and preliminary efficacy of omacetaxine following fixed dose administration in CP or AP CML patients who have failed two or more TKI therapies

citations.quote: 1930-2 Conduct a Phase 1/2 single arm clinical trial to investigate the pharmacokinetic, safety, and preliminary efficacy of omacetaxine following fixed dose administration in patients with chronic phase (CP) or accelerated phase (AP) chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) who have failed two or more TKI therapies.

requirement.text: 1930-3: Conduct a mass balance trial in humans to determine the disposition and elimination pathways and characterize the major metabolites of omacetaxine following subcutaneous injection

citations.quote: 1930-3 Conduct a mass balance trial in humans to determine the disposition and elimination pathways as well as to characterize the major metabolites of omacetaxine following subcutaneous injection. Depending on the results, hepatic and/or renal impairment trials may be required.

orphan_indication.text: Omacetaxine was granted orphan drug designation for treatment of patients with CML on March 10, 2006

citations.quote: Omacetaxine was granted orphan drug designation for treatment of patients with CML in March 10, 2006 exempting it from the requirements of the Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA).

summary.text: Synribo received accelerated approval on the basis of response rate (MCyR in CP CML and MaHR in AP CML) from a post-hoc subset (analysis CML-300) of two single-arm phase 2 trials (CML-202, CML-203), with a required post-marketing confirmatory report of CGX-635-CML-300 with 24-month follow-up; omacetaxine had orphan drug designation for CML. A prior CR letter (April 8, 2010) applied to a separate application (NDA 22374) for the T315I indication, which the applicant forwent.

citations.quote: the recommended regulatory action is accelerated approval of omacetaxine mepesuccinate (subsequently referred to in this review as omacetaxine) as third line therapy for the treatment of accelerated or chronic phase chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML), by subcutaneous route of administration.

The efficacy results from this post-hoc subset analysis of two single-arm trials are adequate given the absence of any approved drug in the third line setting for treatment of CML. This analysis was agreed to by the FDA after the initial application received a CR letter.
Omacetaxine was granted orphan drug designation for treatment of patients with CML in March 10, 2006 exempting it from the requirements of the Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA).

description.text: Fulfilled Subpart H postmarketing requirement (final CGX-635-CML-300 analysis); no change to indication

citations.quote: We approved this NDA under the regulations at 21 CFR 314 Subpart H for accelerated approval of new drugs for serious or life-threatening illnesses. Approval of this supplement fulfills your commitments made under 21 CFR 314.510.
